entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
New Zealand Rugby Chief Financial Officer Chris Kinraid faces questions after NZR rejected several bids to rescue Moana Pasifika | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1 
 
Moana was placed into liquidation in May after previous owners Pasifika Medical Association said it could no longer fund the side after this season, which ended last weekend. The liquidators said the club owed $8.2 million.
 
Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/sport/618687/super-rugby-end-of-the-line-for-moana-pasifika-as-bid-to-rescue-franchise-rejected
